scope: Review of the remaining English, Spanish and Italian members of the Greek genea family after the German decision. Each source member list and evidence distribution is locked before pruning.

keep.reason: Coined via German Gen from Greek genea.

decisions.reason: The remaining strings include personal names and brands (Imogene, Genevan, Genetix), unrelated -gene compounds, malformed tokens and compound-only links such as genepool.

Spanish génesis and its compounds derive from Greek genesis, not genea; gene and other residual strings are foreign tokens, names, brands or unsupported substring matches. The Spanish word gen is not present among this family's members.

Italian genio/genia derive from Latin genius, -geni formations have other immediate etymons, and the rest are names, fragments or accidental strings. No direct genea member is demonstrated in this list.

review_scope: Explicit family-level and list-level judgments. The exclusions are not independent human annotations or proof that every potential true derivative has been found; source lemmas retain other memberships.
